Model of leaf arrangement & branching structure 2.3.1 Leaf arrangement The biological principle states that plant leaves are photosynthetic machines that maximize the absorption of light.
Thus to minimize overlapping individual shadows and achieving the maximum exposure, leaves have evolved the optimal response to mix of environmental elements.
Among such evolutionary features, leaf shape and phyllotaxy are two critical traits that affect the interactions between leaves.
